description: This file defines a cron job scheduler in Go, including the Cron struct, scheduling logic, job management, and internal mechanisms for starting, stopping, and executing scheduled jobs.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Main scheduler struct managing cron entries, execution, and lifecycle.

classes.name: ScheduleParser
classes.description: Interface for parsing schedule specifications into Schedule objects.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Interface representing a job that can be run.

classes.name: Schedule
classes.description: Interface for defining job schedules with a Next method.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a scheduled job with its schedule, next run time, and associated functions.

methods.name: Valid
methods.description: Checks if an Entry is valid (non-zero ID).
